The Arima Kinen... A high-profile race 
featuring immensely popular top-class 
Umamusume. Haru Urara came to watch the 
race in person.

Witnessing the fierce, do-or-die showdown 
between Special Week and Grass Wonder, 
Haru Urara's heart races with excitement.

Wishing to run in a heart-pounding race, 
she loudly declares that she will enter 
the Arima Kinen.

At Haru Urara's words, murmurs of 
"reckless" spread through the crowd.

However, Haru Urara paid no mind to such 
reactions. And thus... to run in the Arima 
Kinen, Haru Urara's bitter, arduous battle 
began!
